articles.title: Lending protocol Bonzo loses 77% of value locked as $9 million oracle exploit rattles Hedera
articles.snippet: Bonzo Lend lost approximately $9.05 million after an attacker exploited a verification flaw in a third-party Supra oracle contract on the Hedera network.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury company Empery Digital sold about half of its BTC stack
articles.snippet: It's a sign of the times as the troubled company swaps its bitcoin treasury ambitions for AI data centers.

articles.title: Bonzo Lend loses $9M in oracle exploit on Hedera
articles.snippet: An attacker inflated the value of SAUCE collateral and borrowed $9 million from Bonzo Lend through a flaw in Supra’s onchain oracle verifier.

articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.6 Sol: Here’s How It Stacks Up Against Other AI Models
articles.snippet: OpenAI's new flagship model is out, after spending two weeks locked behind a government-approved preview. It lands the same week Fable 5 leaves Anthropic's subscription plans.
